# Rich Presence Plus

> Windows application and browser extension that show what you watch, play or listen to as your Discord status. Each presence is a sandboxed script that declares what it can read. Free. Needs the Discord desktop app.

- [Home](https://manucabral.github.io/RichPresencePlus/): what it does, how data flows, questions
- [Presences](https://manucabral.github.io/RichPresencePlus/presences/): every presence, each with the list of what it can read
- [Source code](https://github.com/manucabral/RichPresencePlus)
- [Privacy](https://manucabral.github.io/RichPresencePlus/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://manucabral.github.io/RichPresencePlus/terms/)
